meaning: Explicit typed field projections between domain values and Interface-owned named public contracts, preserving source identity and optional member-position evidence without flattening or effects.
source: Add domainspec.typed-mapping/v3 with inputs, target, target_use, fields and total. Each input has name, type and use. Public type references retain kind contract and qualify the existing contract_id with its interface_selector; they are not Entities or synthetic Value Objects. Old v1/v2 formats remain unchanged.
identity: Public value identity is the pair interface_selector and contract_id. Shared uses of the same contract have the same type. An optional use record separately identifies interface_selector, operation_id and request/result side; it must match the entire declared endpoint type after qualifying its local contracts. Null use means declaration-level binding with no claimed member position. Use evidence never changes value identity or implies an invocation.
types: Preserve scalar, domain named values, qualified public contracts, optional/list/set/sum and existing path/literal/payload-free variant/to_set expressions. Public references retain their Interface scope through nested fields and wrappers. No implicit optional traversal, unwrap, Entity dereference, structural substitution or collection conversion.
target: A target is one domain Entity named reference or one qualified public contract. This matches the current canonical maps target ceiling of Entity or Interface. Fields project named target fields; total true covers all fields including an explicitly empty public contract. Projection does not run a domain factory or establish invariants.
fields: Values read only declared input roots and ontology property/field identities. Defaults retain v2 explicit-nullish-fallback meaning: the primary value must be optional and both its element and fallback must be assignable to the target. Only exact type identity or lifting a nonoptional exact value into its optional target is assignable.
public_closure: Reuse the existing Interface checker over all its public contracts and selected domain declarations: reject direct/transitive Entity embedding, unresolved references and recursive embedding. Domain inputs may be Entities whose fields are explicitly projected into safe public values.
graph: Preserve the current canonical maps edge from Mapping to its target Entity or owning Interface, and existing Interface exposes closure. Authoritative graph source has maps, not maps-from/maps-to verbs; plan wording is treated as endpoint roles, not authorization to add relationships. Input references and member-use evidence are compiler bindings, not invented domain edges.
checked_boundary: Produce a registered immutable checked Mapping from one registered graph, composition and exact field compilation with definition bytes and source evidence. Resolve full Interface-qualified contracts and member uses, retain endpoint descriptors and field/value types, and reject forged, stale or cross-graph artifacts.
compatibility: Add an explicit parser-source selection successor for changed admission bytes; preserve all previous source selections and update only live positive preview fixtures. Existing generators/runtime/proof paths must reject this unsupported new version rather than flattening it. Native v3 generation is R05, not this unit.
non_effects: No native Mapping generation in R04
No transport or Interface member invocation
No new canonical relationship or SFOL/type meaning
No source migration, default cutover or publication
